- Participate in the incident commander rotation and wrote the incident and post-mortem process.

Site Reliability Engineer | Brightwater Games | Leeds
Jan 2019 – Mar 2022

- Replaced a noisy Nagios setup with a Prometheus, Grafana, Alertmanager and Loki observability stack.

- Automated operational tasks with Bash and Python and provided on-call support for customer incidents.

- Built a small Kubernetes controller in Go using controller-runtime to delete expired preview namespaces; the project has approximately 120 GitHub stars.

- Speaker at a UK DevOps meetup in 2024: “SLOs that product managers care about”.

BSc Computer Science | University of the North Moors | 2016

These are candidate-evidence gaps rather than formatting defects, and unsupported terms must not be added.
critique.job_alignment_feedback: The CV aligns strongly with hands-on infrastructure engineering, AWS cloud operation, Terraform, platform design and operation, reliability, observability, technical leadership, stakeholder engagement and Linux. There is also no direct evidence of experience agreeing interfaces with external manufacturers. These are genuine role-fit gaps, not document defects.
